description:
Fresh live-state and MSRV authorization creates the immutable final tag through the fixed-ref primitive and supports exact-tag recovery without stale preparation.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Under the constant publication mutex, protected preflight authenticates rehearsal and escrow, proves final channels absent, runs live MSRV recency last, uploads a one-use prepared record, and calls the authority primitive for annotated v1.0.0 creation.
- [hard] REQ-02: Exact tag object, peeled SHA, manifest, and authority output readback precede completion; an absent tag supersedes stale preparation and repeats full preflight, while an exact existing tag may recovery-complete.
- [hard] REQ-03: Fixtures reject conflicting tags/channels, stale or foreign preparation, unsafe retry, mutation outside the mutex, and recovery without exact escrow/tag/live-state agreement.

## Notes

Blast radius: final-tag authorization/recovery workflow YAML and hosted transition fixtures only.
title: Implement final-tag authorization and recovery workflows
